system.description: Your Frost Bolt ray inflicts an additional 3 damage, or an additional 3 damage as part of a touch or weapon attack. Any creature you hit with Frost Bolt, cold touch, or a cold-enhanced weapon attack is restrained in place (as Winter's Grip). Enabler.
